items.t: Promotes Nevada as a hub for the entertainment business, touting a light regulatory touch and a climate for entrepreneurship.
items.q: Anthony promotes the state as a mecca for the entertainment business, touting a light regulatory touch and a thriving climate for entrepreneurship.

items.t: Has a plan to use space tourism to grow Nevada's entertainment business.
items.q: Nevada Lt. Gov. Stavros Anthony has an unusual plan to rev up the Silver State's entertainment business: space tourism.

record.t: Has served as Nevada Lieutenant Governor alongside Gov. Joe Lombardo since 2022.
record.q: since 2022, has served alongside Gov. Joe Lombardo , leading the Silver State. The Lombardo/Anthony ticket was the only one in America in which Republicans defeated an incumbent Democratic governor and lieutenant governor.

record.t: Was fined $3,000 by the Nevada Commission on Ethics in a 3-2 vote that found he violated state ethics laws, and was ordered to complete ethics training.
record.q: In a 3-2 vote, the commission determined Anthony violated state ethics laws. As part of their formal rebuke, members imposed a $3,000 civil penalty and mandated completion of ethics training.

record.office: Police captain, Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department
record.t: Served as a Las Vegas Metropolitan Police captain in charge of several divisions and retired after 29 years of service.
record.q: As a captain, Anthony spent time in charge of many divisions within Metro including Vice/Narcotics, Northeast Area Command and the Transportation Safety Bureau. He retired after 29 years of service.

record.t: Served as a member of the Nevada System of Higher Education Board of Regents and as a City of Las Vegas Councilman before becoming Lieutenant Governor.
record.q: a member of the Nevada System of Higher Education Board of Regents, as a City of Las Vegas Councilman and now as Nevada Lieutenant Governor.
